title: Time Complexity [Learn Basics, and then analyse in next Steps]
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
intro: Time/space complexity is how you predict scale. Count dominant operations, drop constants, and state assumptions (sorted? hash O(1)?). Classic framing from the roadmap note “time and space complexity strivers a2z dsa course”.
intuition: Ask: if n doubles, does work double, square, or jump exponentially?
approach: Express in n, m, k from constraints.
Cross-check against time limits (~1e8 ops/sec rule of thumb).
pitfalls: Claiming hash ops are always O(1) worst-case.
